s01167.summary: Solene readies herself at the base of the climbing wall
Solene races up the wall, slips at the crux, and misses the record
A tape of her younger self tells her to breathe at the third hold
Solene wipes her tears, chalks up, and climbs again, pausing to breathe
She breaks the record and hugs the boombox to her chest

s00748.summary: Veteran executive Hortense sits in her sterile corner office facing the speakerphone
Archibald calls and waves from the tower opposite, having moved his desk
Archibald brandishes a reorganisation binder threatening her Henderson account
Archibald announces that under the plan Hortense reports to him
Hortense coolly tells him people with binders fear people without them
Hortense writes and displays a resignation sign; Archibald fumbles his binder
Hortense hangs up, leaves a clock behind, and walks out as Archibald stares

s00730.summary: Orrin climbs into his dead friend's dusty library and greets it softly
Orrin reads his friend's letter bequeathing him the lonely book
Orrin opens the book, it glows and turns its own pages for him

s01818.summary: Caleb and Rosalie meet a wandering priest in the ruined mission courtyard
Rosalie questions the empty fountain and the priest answers gently
The priest shares terrible but warm coffee, easing Caleb
Caleb reveals he came to scatter his wife's ashes where they married
The priest blesses her and the ashes drift away as Rosalie says goodbye

s02391.summary: Theo declares the lemon slice the one while Gabriel wants to try all
They feed each other the almond and settle their order
Alone, Theo admits he only wanted to watch Gabriel pick
Gabriel presses lemon cake into his face as Marguerite deadpans

s01137.summary: Disguised as tourists, Suki and Moses plan to steal a rare orchid
The gardener Ulrich reveals he knows exactly what they are after
Ulrich offers a live cutting instead, and they follow him

s01629.summary: The group barricades the telegraph office as the key repeats hold
Crane recognizes the voice outside as Tommy, buried Tuesday
As the roar builds, Crane draws and orders no one to fire
The roar passes and the line reports all clear

s00758.summary: Saoirse and Delphine begin Eustace's MRI scan
They see the shadow is not a tumour and share relief
The magnet yanks his ring and a tray; they slam emergency stops
They pull Eustace free and he laughs about his forty-year ring

s02273.summary: On the ferry bocce court, Tonino accuses Marcello of nudging the pallino
Losing by a thumbnail, Tonino knocks Marcello's bowl overboard

s02034.summary: Marcel needs a spare to win the championship as Gert taunts him
Marcel bowls and leaves three pins standing; Gert smirks
Marcel hurls the ball in fury and it ricochets to fell the pins
They all laugh, the shot counts, and rivals shake hands

s01337.summary: Guests gather for a seance as the table begins to knock
The Commodore calls to dead Edmund despite Miriam's objection; three knocks answer
Tull blames the tide, the room darkens, and Miriam walks out
Madame reveals she knows Miriam is Theodora's mother

s00158_0.summary: A lantern-lit gold rush dentist tent advertises cheap tooth pulling

s00342.summary: Nonna and Big Walt's bowls collide and the pallino rolls under a chair
They argue over the point until Darius measures it for Nonna
Nonna sips her espresso and graciously offers the thermos to Walt

s00269.summary: A bloodied woman joins an armed man in a descending freight elevator
She questions him about the missing third and the plan
She pulls his false papers and demands his real name to shoot
The lights die and they struggle until she pins him
He reveals he is Stefan, her lost brother; she slaps then hugs him

s00446.summary: Agent Solomon guards Dr. Brady and a cuffed briefcase in a descending elevator
A janitor boards with his cart, and Solomon's hand drifts to his jacket
The janitor reveals a blade and Solomon fights him in the dark
Solomon hands over the briefcase in the lobby and walks out

s02454.summary: Dorothea furiously preps funeral food and snipes at Stanley about the spoons
Dorothea blames Stanley for abandoning Mama during her illness
Stanley slams the casserole and Rosalind intervenes, warning upstairs can hear
Stanley says Mama loved a good fight and Dorothea almost smiles
Rosalind makes them promise kindness and they carry dishes upstairs together

s00664.summary: Eli finds Cassidy on the storage rooftop after she left prom
Cassidy explains the curtain-dress insult, laughs, then breaks down
Eli offers to stay despite hating heights, and shares warm soda
They agree everyone is faking and hold hands
Cassidy snatches his phone until Eli admits he's glad he came
Eli ignores the phone and asks for a dance; she accepts

s02139.summary: Perpetua serves drifter Jubal while Deputy Tasker nervously questions him
Bounty hunter Belle bursts in with a rifle and overrules the deputy
Belle lays down Jubal's wanted poster and silences Tasker
Jubal claims he helped a judge's man vanish, implicating the poster's signer
Belle checks the seal and Tasker confirms Judge Garrity's signature
Belle folds the poster, takes stew, and they eat in wary silence

s00824.summary: On her last day, Odalys plays an old tape of her younger self
Her recorded voice recalls the ferry schedule and calls it a good job
Odalys pockets the stamp, agrees it was, and pulls the shutter down

s02128.summary: In the ticking shop, Solomon reads the will to the assembled family
The Brandt clock goes to whoever kept it running, and Kaspar claims it
Teddy says the clock was sabotaged; Mireille notes Kaspar's clean hands
The bequest fails; Mireille pockets the winding key from his body
Mireille leaves with a parting jab, and Kaspar's watch stops
Teddy hints she has the weights and leaves; Rossiter demands the will

s00759.summary: In a funeral home, Barnabas deposes Hollis amid Rosamund's objections
The funeral director interrupts to offer tissues
A pitcher spills across the exhibits and everyone mops with black linen

s01974.summary: Dragan holds Kestrel at gunpoint, demanding her bag of ledgers
Inspector Rosalind arrives, but she and Dragan clearly know each other
Kestrel realizes Rosalind came for the bag, not to arrest Dragan
A stranger on the catwalk interrupts and Kestrel surrenders the bag
The bag is empty; Kestrel has flooded the dock with the laptop
Rosalind runs, Alvaro applauds, and Kestrel climbs out past him

s01541.summary: Lakshmi questions a hooded inspector with no logged clearance
The station orders a rescan and Lakshmi finds fungal contamination
Roots bend to the Inspector, who unhoods and calls himself the contamination
Lakshmi tries to seal the ring but the station asks if she's specimen
He asks why the seeds were buried in darkness
He names himself Ambrose and Lakshmi softens, putting down the scanner
The ring turns green and Lakshmi declares herself specimen

s01531_0.summary: Milo teases Zeke over the smudged number a girl wrote on his hand
June shouts outside and the boys bolt, colliding in the doorway

s01803.summary: Hester challenges Leopold's alibi with the mystery of the second lamp
Hester presses Clementine and notes the moved, warm telescope canvas
Clementine confesses she was there and lied because Leopold told her
